result: Set in Agrabah, the story follows a kind-hearted street urchin named Aladdin as he vies for the love of the beautiful Princess Jasmine. His pursuit takes a dramatic turn when he finds a magic lamp. Hoping to fulfill his dream to marry her, Aladdin uses the magic power of the genie to make himself into a prince.

Along with his romantic pursuit, Aladdin is on a critical mission to stop the powerful Jafar. Jafar is currently plotting to steal the magic lamp, driven by the desire to make his deepest wishes come true through its magic. Aladdin must successfully stop Jafar before the powerful figure can obtain the lamp and fulfill his ultimate ambitions.
